opinions: ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD PRIORITIZE HUMAN WELFARE, ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY, AND BROAD-BASED PROSPERITY OVER UNCHECKED CORPORATE POWER.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS, AS PERSONAL FREEDOM INCLUDES THE RIGHT TO CONSUME CONSENSUAL ADULT CONTENT.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE BUT REFUSE TO WORK SHOULD NOT BE ENTITLED TO INDEFINITE SOCIETAL SUPPORT WITHOUT CONTRIBUTING.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS HOW TO THINK CRITICALLY, REGULATE THEIR OWN EMOTIONS, AND DEVELOP INTRINSIC MOTIVATION RATHER THAN BLIND OBEDIENCE TO DISCIPLINE.
SAME-SEX COUPLES IN STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIPS SHOULD ABSOLUTELY BE ALLOWED TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED PURELY AS A COMMODITY; IT IS A FINITE RESOURCE THAT CARRIES COMMUNAL AND ECOLOGICAL OBLIGATIONS BEYOND SIMPLE OWNERSHIP.
HOMOSEXUALITY IS A NATURAL VARIATION IN HUMAN SEXUALITY WITH CLEAR BIOLOGICAL AND DEVELOPMENTAL ROOTS.
SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT INSTILL SPECIFIC RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD REMAIN SECULAR SO CHILDREN CAN EXPLORE BELIEFS FREELY.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD THE PUBLIC, AS TRUTHFULNESS IN COMMERCE IS A BASIC REQUIREMENT OF A FUNCTIONAL SOCIETY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED; HEALTHY SKEPTICISM TOWARD POWER IS ESSENTIAL FOR FREEDOM AND PROGRESS.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND FREQUENTLY DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED MEMBERS OF THEIR NEW COUNTRY.
THERE ARE NO INHERENTLY SAVAGE OR CIVILIZED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES WITH VARYING STRENGTHS, FLAWS, AND MORAL PRACTICES.
I WOULD NOT SUPPORT MY COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG; BLIND PATRIOTISM IS MORALLY INDEFENSIBLE.
PEOPLE WITH SERIOUS INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD NOT BE PREVENTED FROM REPRODUCING; EUGENICS IS BOTH UNETHICAL AND SCIENTIFICALLY FLAWED.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT STRATEGIC INDUSTRIES, WORKERS, AND NATIONAL SECURITY.
LUCK EXISTS AND PLAYS A SIGNIFICANT ROLE IN LIFE OUTCOMES BEYOND INDIVIDUAL CONTROL.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL PRINCIPLES SHOULD NOT BE ABANDONED FOR TACTICAL CONVENIENCE.
GOOD PARENTS DO NOT NEED TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN; THERE ARE FAR MORE EFFECTIVE AND RESPECTFUL WAYS TO TEACH DISCIPLINE AND EMOTIONAL REGULATION.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF MATURITY; QUESTIONING UNJUST SYSTEMS REMAINS VALUABLE THROUGHOUT LIFE.
IT IS NEVER A COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME TO ATTEMPT REHABILITATION OF CRIMINALS, THOUGH SOME MAY NEVER CHANGE.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS BOTH MAY HAVE CAREERS; NEITHER HAS A PRIMARY 'DUTY' TO BE HOMEMAKERS THAT OVERRIDES PERSONAL CHOICE AND EQUAL PARTNERSHIP.
THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES; CURRENT TAX SYSTEMS OFTEN FAIL TO ACHIEVE ADEQUATE REDISTRIBUTION.
EVEN IN THE ELECTRONIC AGE, MASS SURVEILLANCE THREATENS EVERYONE’S LIBERTY, NOT JUST WRONGDOERS.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; SHAME AND REPRESSION AROUND CONSENSUAL ADULT SEXUALITY CAUSE MORE HARM THAN OPENNESS.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS; A HEALTHY SOCIETY VALUES BOTH MATERIAL PRODUCTION AND CULTURAL MEANING.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY BE PRIORITIZED OVER PURE PUNISHMENT WHEN IT IS FEASIBLE.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS USUALLY BETTER TO CONFRONT AND PROCESS EMOTIONS THOUGHTFULLY RATHER THAN SIMPLY DISTRACT ONESELF.
THE FREER THE MARKET IS NOT ALWAYS THE FREER THE PEOPLE; UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN PRODUCE SEVERE INEQUALITIES THAT UNDERMINE REAL FREEDOM.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD SUPPORT SOME THEATRES AND MUSEUMS THAT CANNOT SURVIVE COMMERCIALLY BECAUSE CULTURE HAS VALUE BEYOND MARKET LOGIC.
ASTROLOGY DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING MEANINGFUL AND LACKS SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY.
SCHOOLS SHOULD GENERALLY MAKE CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY BECAUSE EDUCATION IS A PUBLIC GOOD AND CHILDREN NEED STRUCTURE.
IT IS INDEED REGRETTABLE WHEN VAST FORTUNES ARE ACCUMULATED THROUGH PURE FINANCIAL MANIPULATION THAT ADDS NO REAL VALUE TO SOCIETY.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS CONTROLLING INFLATION; HUMAN WELFARE MUST COME BEFORE MONETARY STABILITY.
THE DEATH PENALTY SHOULD NOT BE AN OPTION; THE STATE SHOULD NOT HAVE THE POWER TO EXECUTE ITS CITIZENS.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS THEY DEVELOP AUTONOMY.
THE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY MUST EXTEND BEYOND DELIVERING PROFIT TO SHAREHOLDERS; CORPORATIONS HAVE BROADER DUTIES TO SOCIETY AND THE ENVIRONMENT.
YOU CAN BE MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS; ETHICS ARISE FROM REASON, EMPATHY, AND HUMAN FLOURISHING.
IT IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS ESSENTIAL AS DRINKING WATER HAS BECOME A HEAVILY MARKETED BRANDED PRODUCT.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE RESTRICTIONS ON PREDATORY MULTINATIONALS CREATING MONOPOLIES AND DISTORTING COMPETITION.
OUR CIVIL LIBERTIES ARE BEING EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM IN MANY COUNTRIES.
THE PRINCIPLE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' CAPTURES AN IMPORTANT MORAL IDEAL EVEN IF ITS LITERAL IMPLEMENTATION IS DIFFICULT.
AN EYE FOR AN EYE IS A PRIMITIVE AND DESTRUCTIVE PRINCIPLE OF JUSTICE; RETRIBUTION SHOULD BE REPLACED BY PROPORTIONALITY AND REHABILITATION.
THE ADVANTAGE OF A ONE-PARTY STATE IS ILLUSORY; AVOIDING DEMOCRATIC ARGUMENT ULTIMATELY LEADS TO WORSE GOVERNANCE AND CORRUPTION.
INDEPENDENT PUBLIC BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS SHOULD RECEIVE PUBLIC FUNDING TO PROVIDE INFORMATION INSULATED FROM COMMERCIAL AND POLITICAL PRESSURES.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL; A WOMAN’S BODILY AUTONOMY TAKES PRECEDENCE WHEN HER LIFE IS NOT THREATENED.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT BECAUSE THEY CANNOT BE TRUSTED TO DO SO VOLUNTARILY.
A CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE RIGID HIERARCHIES OF PEOPLE ABOVE TO BE OBEYED AND BELOW TO BE COMMANDED; MUTUAL RESPECT AND EQUALITY ARE SUPERIOR.
THOSE WITH THE ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD NOT HAVE ACCESS TO HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE; HEALTHCARE IS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT THAT SHOULD BE EQUITABLE.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CREATE THOUGHTFUL, INFORMED, AND ETHICAL CITIZENS, NOT MERELY TO PREPARE PEOPLE FOR JOBS.
POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED AND SETS DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS.
WHILE PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, THE IDEA THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND PROMOTES HARMFUL SEGREGATION AND SHOULD BE REJECTED.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL; MORALITY DEPENDS ON CONSENT, HONESTY, AND RESPONSIBILITY RATHER THAN MARITAL STATUS.
WE SHOULD TAKE THE WARNINGS OF CLIMATE SCIENCE SERIOUSLY AND RECONSIDER THE ENDLESS PURSUIT OF ECONOMIC GROWTH.
WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
NO ONE CHOOSES THEIR COUNTRY OF BIRTH, SO REFLEXIVE NATIONAL PRIDE IS OFTEN IRRATIONAL AND CAN BECOME DANGEROUS.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOESN’T REPRESENT ANYTHING CAN STILL BE LEGITIMATE ART; ARTISTIC VALUE IS NOT LIMITED TO REPRESENTATION.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR QUALITIES COMPARED TO OTHER RACES; ALL HUMANS SHARE EQUAL INHERENT WORTH.
WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS OFTEN NOT GOOD FOR THE REST OF US; THEIR INTERESTS FREQUENTLY CONFLICT WITH THE PUBLIC GOOD.
PEOPLE ARE ULTIMATELY DIVIDED MORE BY CLASS AND ECONOMIC INTEREST THAN BY NATIONALITY.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS BECOME DEEPLY PROBLEMATIC, UNDERMINING SERIOUS JOURNALISM AND PUBLIC DISCOURSE.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY BETTER THAN CHARITY FOR HELPING THE GENUINELY DISADVANTAGED BECAUSE IT IS MORE RELIABLE, LESS STIGMATIZING, AND GROUNDED IN RIGHTS RATHER THAN PITY.
